rationale: ICT cluster site publishes recurring member news and aggregated job openings - a live standalone signal hub, not just a one-off directory.
Play Store listing keeps producing versioned publisher/developer metadata that attributes a ME bank's channel stack to its vendor.
Single customer-notice page documenting a Halcom-to-eMon supplier swap - strong evidence artifact; monitor the bank domain instead.
Vendor regional site with bank/partner and CA listings; changes reveal ME bank wins and losses.
Regional job board with a stable filtered query; vendor vacancies are the most granular hiring signal for ME/regional service build-out.
Leading ME employment portal, IT category feed - primary local channel for a vendor opening a Podgorica office.
Second ME job aggregator; redundancy is justified since vendor ads post unevenly and expire fast.
Third-tier ME job board, lower credibility but catches SME integrator and field-service roles missing elsewhere.
Job board with persistent employer profile pages enabling per-vendor hiring-cadence tracking.
Authoritative company registry search - hardest evidence of vendor incorporation, branch registration and director change in Montenegro.
Static e-service procedure page on euprava.me with siblings; vocabulary reference only, and URL did not verify.
Dedicated ME banking/finance trade portal category feed where supplier and bank programme announcements land first.
Domestic ICT news portal covering the supplier side - hiring waves and company growth; complements Bankar.me.
EMIS company profile is a paywalled commercial database page for one integrator; requires subscription clearance before any value.
Scheme-side acquiring-bank list is a valuable demand-side roster but URL failed verification - recheck liveness.
Serbian card-personalisation vendor page with no confirmed ME customer link; weak and speculative.
Chamber homepage carries member news and sector-board activity; parent of the more valuable board rosters.
Bank association would be the canonical member/actor enumeration, but the URL is an unconfirmed inference from the acronym - resolve first.
Named banking/finance board roster is high-value but is a komora.me sub-page; diffing it can ride on the parent chamber monitor.
Chamber governance pages sit under the same komora.me parent; useful leadership diffs, no standalone monitoring needed.
MFIC committee pages enumerate foreign-owned bank and card-scheme actors with named representatives and refresh with board elections.
AmCham Board of Governors is a recurring, employer-attributed leadership-move feed spanning banks and payments-adjacent IT firms.
Member registry appears account-gated and failed verification; a human must confirm access before any one-off mining.
Employers federation board page - executive seats plus labour/jobs policy counterpart, on-topic for the hiring workstream.
Managers association member and board listings map named bank executives to employers - individual-level granularity nothing else offers.
Single trade-press article announcing the CFO association founding board; evidence artifact, track the body via AMM and Bankar.me feeds.
Regulator-run fintech hub, public and legally clear, is the de facto enumeration of ME payment/fintech actors and working groups.
